É quantos padrões temporais o PCA guarda: It is how many temporal patterns the PCA holds in each cluster. The 1st is the pattern that most explains the differences between series (e.g., stronger or weaker morning peak), the 2nd is the second most important, and so on. Each series turns:
média do cluster + peso₁ × padrão₁ + pes: cluster average + weight1 × standard1 + weight2 × standard2 + ...
Na estimativa, só existe o começo da sér: In the estimate, there is only the beginning of the series (partial simulation). The PCA finds the weights that reproduce this beginning and uses the same weights to rebuild the entire series.
só a forma geral; estável, mas perde det: only the general form; stable, but loses details.

Um caminho absoluto por linha, acessível: One absolute path per line, accessible to both the API and engine. Order: application.conf → listed files → edits below. The last value takes precedence; HOCON includes and substitutions are preserved. Restart the engine to apply.
Conexão interrompida; dados podem estar: Connection interrupted; data may be outdated.
Sem relatos de passageiros para este loc: No passenger reports for this location at the selected time.
Valores observados no stream; linhas sem: Observed stream values; lines without reports are omitted. Occupancy refers to the last observed vehicle, not the entire line.
Seleciona a configuração incluída no eng: Selects a configuration bundled with the engine, equivalent to -Dconfig.resource. No server path is needed.
Um caminho absoluto por linha, acessível: One absolute path per line, accessible to the API and engine. Order: selected base configuration → listed files → overrides below. The last value wins; HOCON includes and substitutions are preserved. Restart the engine to apply.
JVM process metrics include concurrent j: JVM process metrics include concurrent jobs. CPU cores may exceed 1. Peaks are sampled.
Recent bounded samples; phase totals cov: Recent bounded samples; phase totals cover the full stage.
Low free disk space on the output filesy: Low free disk space on the output filesystem. Free space or move SimEDaPE data before another training run.
Resultados excluídos. O ClickHouse liber: Results deleted. ClickHouse reclaims disk space in the background.
Excluir permanentemente os resultados de: Permanently delete results for {0} in {1}? Stop the simulation before deleting. This cannot be undone.
Workers livres recebem novos lotes, dent: Free workers take new batches within the service CPU and memory limits.
FastDTW pode alterar os caminhos e as es: FastDTW can change paths and estimates. The radius controls the search: larger values expand refinement. Compare estimation error after training.
Corrija os parâmetros do treino antes de: Correct the training settings before applying them.
Escolha uma execução concluída, interrom: Choose a completed, interrupted or failed run. Resuming creates a new snapshot and preserves the original run.
Aplicar os parâmetros atuais do treino;: Apply current training settings; changes may require recomputing steps.
Salvar também a base carregada e normali: Also save loaded and normalized data for future recovery. Uses additional disk space.

No reusable loaded-data checkpoint; the: No reusable loaded-data checkpoint; the original baseline will be read again.

The saved model retained fewer occupied: The saved model retained fewer occupied clusters or has an incomplete fit; recovery preserves that clustering.
The baseline must be unchanged when reus: The baseline must be unchanged when reusing a model without saved input data.
Agrupado: um valor final por via e insta: Grouped: one final value per link and timestamp, preserving vehicles. Requires complete enter/leave history from empty links; CSV needs event_type. Changing this requires new training. Seconds without events are not filled.

Completed standalone DTW archives will b: Completed standalone DTW archives will be reused; only diagnostics and pending training steps run. Keep the source snapshot until export completes.
Cada cluster é treinado separadamente. A: Each cluster is trained separately. The target selects the smallest count retaining the requested variance; counts can differ across clusters. Higher targets store more weights.
compare os resultados por cluster e o e: compare per-cluster results and error in the Estimate step. Explained variance measures representation of training data; it does not guarantee estimation accuracy.
Clusters sem variação não têm percentual: Clusters without variation have no defined variance percentage.
A meta de variância do PCA deve estar en: The PCA variance target must be greater than 0 and at most 100%.
